newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLAND V ITALY WORLD CUP TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLAND V ITALY WORLD CUP TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for the England v Italy World Cup European group two qualifying match at Wembley on Wednesday:
England - 1-Ian Walker, 2-Gary Neville, 3-Stuart Pearce, 4-Paul Ince, 5-Sol Campbell, 6-Graham Le Saux, 7-David Beckham, 8-David Batty, 9-Alan Shearer, 10-Matt Le Tissier, 11-Steve McManaman.

Italy - 1-Angelo Peruzzi, 2-Ciro Ferrara, 3-Paolo Maldini, 4-Dino Baggio, 5-Fabio Cannavaro, 6-Alessandro Costacurta, 7-Angelo Di Livio, 8-Roberto Di Matteo, 9-Pierluigi Casiraghi, 10-Demitrio Albertini, 11-Gianfranco Zola.
